findings.highlight: Rider is simply no match for Saber's raw power.
findings.evidenceJa: 瞬間的な爆発力では、ライダーはセイバーには及ばない。
findings.governingReading: Rider cannot match Saber’s instantaneous explosive movement, allowing one brief breakaway before she closes again.
findings.explanation: Instant burst movement advantage becomes raw power.

findings.highlight: She's probably thought more than once about not wanting to push her Master to do anything crazy.
findings.evidenceJa: あの愚直なマスターに、これ以上無理をさせたくないと、一度でも思ってしまったのだから。
findings.governingReading: Once she has ever wanted to spare her obstinate Master further strain, she cannot turn back from protecting him.
findings.explanation: Having cared even once becomes probably caring more than once.

findings.highlight: So before that happens...if I can make Shinji use up his Command Spells, Rider might stop fighting.
findings.evidenceJa: だからその前に—慎二を見つけて令呪を使わせてしまえば、ライダーと戦う必要はなくなる筈だ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou expects that finding Shinji and making him use a Command Spell will remove the need to fight Rider. Neither the remaining count nor the intended order is specified.
findings.explanation: Making Shinji use a Command Spell becomes making him use up his supply. The Japanese leaves the count and intended order unstated and expects the need to fight Rider to end.
